title: [Bug] Claude 使用 function call + 开启限制历史消息数功能，报错：messages.0: `tool_use` blocks can only be in `assistant` messages
body:
### 📦 部署环境

Vercel

### 📦 部署模式

服务端模式(lobe-chat-database 镜像)

### 📌 软件版本

1.65.0

### 💻 系统环境

Windows

### 🌐 浏览器

Chrome

### 🐛 问题描述

Claude 使用 function call + 开启限制历史消息数功能，报错：messages.0: `tool_use` blocks can only be in `assistant` messages

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/4ba490b4-72f6-4285-9dfc-cb2b946f8ec8)

### 📷 复现步骤

复现条件：
- 使用 claude-3-7-sonnet-20250219 模型（即支持 function call 功能）
- 开启插件功能，比如 searxng
- 开启「限制历史消息数」功能，假设为 2 

结果：
```
{
  "error": {
    "error": {
      "type": "error",
      "error": {
        "type": "invalid_request_error",
        "message": "messages.0: `tool_use` blocks can only be in `assistant` messages"
      }
    },
    "status": 400,
    "headers": {
      "via": "1.1 google",
      "date": "Thu, 27 Feb 2025 01:49:56 GMT",
      "connection": "keep-alive",
      "request-id": "req_01ED9tngMDhnUpDXyx4jwfUP",
      "content-type": "application/json",
      "x-robots-tag": "none",
      "content-length": "135",
      "x-should-retry": "false",
      "anthropic-organization-id": "d269df32-4f2e-40cd-bfd1-b3491bd379ba"
    },
    "request_id": "req_01ED9tngMDhnUpDXyx4jwfUP"
  },
  "endpoint": "https://api.anthropic.com",
  "provider": "anthropic"
}
```


### 🚦 期望结果

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/20f20e31-c1fe-4fba-8971-911649b88c52)
